Description: Multi-stop spectral thin-film optical wave interference driven by view angle, film thickness (nm), refractive index (IOR), and surface normal curvature for haute-couture iridescent silks and crystal coatings.

Inputs.Name: FilmThickness_nm
Inputs.Description: Physical thickness of the thin optical layer in nanometers (d).

Inputs.Name: FilmIOR
Inputs.Description: Refractive index of the thin coating layer (n1).

Inputs.Name: SubstrateIOR
Inputs.Description: Refractive index of the underlying fabric or dielectric substrate (n2).

Inputs.Name: Normal
Inputs.Description: Normalized surface normal vector in world space.

Inputs.Name: CurvatureMask
Inputs.Description: Surface curvature mask for modulating local thin-film thickness in organic folds.

Inputs.Name: IridescenceIntensity
Inputs.Description: Overall amplitude multiplier for spectral interference reflections.

Inputs.Name: BaseReflectanceTint
Inputs.Description: Multi-stop chromatic tint applied to interference fringes.

Inputs.Name: SpectralGradientTex
Inputs.Description: Optional multi-stop 1D/2D LUT for stylized color remapping.

Inputs.Name: UseSpectralLUT
Inputs.Description: Toggle between physical Airy cosine math and LUT texture lookup.

Outputs.Name: PhaseShift
Outputs.Description: Normalized optical phase [0.0, 1.0] for driving secondary procedural masks.

Outputs.Name: ModulatedRoughness
Outputs.Description: Micro-roughness perturbation derived from optical interference fringes.

Outputs.Name: Substrate_F0
Outputs.Description: Specular F0 reflectance vector for direct Substrate Slab BSDF wiring.
